newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus bans or curbs many imports and exports.
newsitem.headline: Belarus bans or curbs many imports and exports.

text.p: Belarus will limit imports printing and video equipment, information technology, tobacco and alcohol and limit exports of jewellery and ferrous and non-ferrous metals, government spokesman Dmitry Malynovsky said on Tuesday.
"Banned are imports and exports of printing, video and audio equipment bearing information aimed at bringing political or economic harm to the country," he told reporters.
He said government permission would have to be sought for imports or exports of restricted items.
The order would come into affect a month after the government published details and lists of items in local media, but did not say when publication would take place.
Belarus has signed a customs union with neighbouring Russia, but the two sides have been wrangling about curbs on the activities of Russian journalists based in the capital Minsk.
